sources.label: NAUR LesBin - UltiProject: full FRU Phase 5 guide
NAUR LesBin - P5 Exawaves center-dodge guides

steps.title: Gather in the open pocket
steps.rule: All eight meet in the pocket the six seams leave open: 7m off the centre on a cardinal, inside the corner where the three crossing pairs meet.

steps.title: Dodge into the first corner
steps.cue: the Path of Light and Path of Darkness casts start
steps.rule: Step into the corner of the pocket the first pair of seams leaves safe, right inside their crossing, and wait for the first strips to fire.

steps.title: Follow the strips through the pocket
steps.rule: Each strip rolls on 5m every two seconds: after every wave, step into the space it just cleared, keeping inside the pocket, until the last pair has passed.

steps.title: Light parties for Akh Morn
steps.rule: Split into the two light parties either side of Pandora, about 6m out from the pocket: MT, RH, M1 and R a little clockwise of it, OT, SH, M2 and C a little counter-clockwise. Each side's stack lands on one of its four.
